channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Nextify.ai Review (2026): 3,000 Credits Is 62 Clips
item.description: Nextify.ai: Free is $0 for 50 credits a month, watermarked, on the basic models only. The plans are sold in videos and images.

item.title: Code Bulk Discounts Review (2026): From $14.99/mo
item.description: Code Bulk Discounts: Two plans, billed in USD every 30 days. Read the free plan's number twice, because the word doing the work is 'lifetime'.

item.title: Kite Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: Kite: The Free plan is free to install and covers the first 50 discount orders each month. 'Free to install' is doing a lot of work on this listing.

item.title: Stackable Review (2026): From $19.99/mo, Checked Sep 2026
item.description: Stackable: Unlimited is $99.99 a month, or $999.99 a year on the same 17%. The two halves of the pitch are priced five times apart.

item.title: Mycroft Review (2026): A Feature List With the Prices Removed
item.description: Mycroft has no public pricing: three packages, and not one number between them. The pricing page is a feature list with the prices taken out.

item.title: Claap Review (2026): The Sales Half Costs €48 and a Phone Call
item.description: Claap: Pro is €24 per license a month billed yearly or €30 monthly. The four tiers sell two different products.

item.title: Easy Bundles Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $29/mo
item.description: Easy Bundles: The free plan is free to install and covers up to $500 of bundle sales a month. The pricing is tied to the thing the app is supposed to grow.

item.title: Smarty Discounts Review (2026): $9.99/mo Is the Entry Price
item.description: Smarty Discounts: Forever Free costs nothing, Lite is $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year. Add to that what the app needs to do its job.

item.title: Modge Review (2026): $4 a Seat, Screenshots Off by Default
item.description: Modge: Basic is $5 per seat per month billed monthly or $4 billed annually. The numbers on Modge's own pages do not agree with each other.

item.title: BrowserAct Review (2026): Pay Monthly, Pay Up to Double
item.description: BrowserAct: Free Trial is $0 with 1,500 credits on signup and 5 free local browser profiles. The yearly toggle wears a -20% badge.

item.title: Pumper Bundles Review (2026): Same Features, You Pay for Headroom
item.description: Pumper Bundles: Free covers up to $300 of extra revenue generated by the app. The bill therefore rises exactly when the app is working, and it rises in steps.

item.title: Upsell.com Review (2026): The Listed Tiers Stop at 200 Orders
item.description: Upsell.com: The free plan is for development stores only, not a live shop. The prices on the listing are the bottom three rungs of a ladder that keeps going.

item.title: Wiz Checkout Upsell Review (2026): Checkout Half Starts at $99
item.description: Wiz Checkout Upsell: Plus Growth is $99 a month, or $999 a year (the listing says that saves 16%). Everything the app is named after.

item.title: PreOrder Now Review (2026): From $19.95/mo, Checked Sep 2026
item.description: PreOrder Now: Five tiers, and they are named after your Shopify plan rather than after what the app does. The free tier is more useful than it first looks.

item.title: Evey Events Review (2026): Free to Install, $1 a Ticket
item.description: Evey Events: Lite is free to install and takes $1.00 per ticket. Nobody gets caught by the monthly fee here; they get caught by the per-ticket one.

item.title: Kiwi Sizing Review (2026): From $7.99/mo, Checked Sep 2026
item.description: Kiwi Sizing: Free publishes up to three size charts with 22 templates and unlimited CSV import. Three charts is generous for a small catalogue.

item.title: Bitscale Review (2026): 200 Free Credits, Then $349/mo
item.description: Bitscale: Free is $0 with 200 credits, no card required, capped at 20 action columns per grid. The free tier is real and needs no card.

item.title: RocketReach Review (2026): From $19/mo, Searches Capped at 100
item.description: RocketReach — A free account exists: signing up takes no credit card and gives a limited number of lookups. The published prices are annual rates.

item.title: Optizen Review (2026): Shopify Video Upsells, AI Clips Metered
item.description: Optizen: Three tiers, billed in USD. AI video is the reason to install this, and it is the one thing the subscription does not cover.

item.title: Post Purchase Upsell Hero Review (2026): 2.5% of Upsell Revenue
item.description: Post Purchase Upsell Hero: One plan, Performance, at $0 a month plus usage charges, billed in USD. The 2.5% comes off revenue, not margin.

item.title: UpsellPlus Review (2026): Upsells Everywhere, Priced on Revenue
item.description: UpsellPlus: Four tiers, billed in USD, with a 14-day free trial on the paid ones. The $49 buys offers and features, not headroom — headroom starts at $119.

item.title: Easy Advanced Translations Review (2026): Bring Your Own API Key
item.description: Easy Advanced Translations: Four tiers, all monthly. The 'free AI' is heavily quota-limited — 50 products on Free, up to 800 on Pro.

item.title: Ava AI Review (2026): Shopify Phone Agent, Metered by the Minute
item.description: Ava AI: Support is $29 a month and includes 100 call minutes, then $0.10 a minute. The monthly price is a minutes allowance, not a flat fee.

item.title: SupaEasy Review (2026): No-Code Shopify Functions, AI at $99
item.description: SupaEasy: A free plan plus three paid monthly tiers, each with a 7-day trial. The 'free' plan is development-stores only, so any live use is paid.

item.title: Rippling Review (2026): HR, IT and Finance, Priced by Quote
item.description: Rippling is modular and mostly quote-led. The published '$8 per user a month' is real but it's only the floor, and it's the HR-and-payroll entry.

item.title: Pecan AI Review (2026): Priced by Prediction Batches, Not Seats
item.description: Pecan AI: No public price at any tier. The pricing page argues instead of quoting.

item.title: SupportBee Review (2026): From $20/mo, Checked Aug 2026
item.description: SupportBee: Month to month, Startup is $20/seat/month and Enterprise is $25/seat/month. Enterprise is listed as everything in Startup plus five named items.

item.title: PartnerStack Review (2026): Quote-Only, We Run 58 Programmes
item.description: PartnerStack publishes three plans — Launch, Growth and Enterprise. A record in the Partner API's customers endpoint is a tracked click, not a signup.

item.title: Surfer SEO Review (2026): The Monthly Rate Is a Yearly Deal
item.description: Surfer (SurferSEO): $120, $240, $444, $720 and $324 a year. Every tier quotes its monthly rate on annual billing.

item.title: Datarails Review (2026): Excel-Native FP&A, Quote Only
item.description: Datarails publishes three plans. You cannot find out what it costs without talking to sales, and the entry plan is smaller than it looks.
